documents: Government Resolution GR-2024/CR-45/AGR-7 dated 2024-08-15 by Agriculture Department. Subject: Solar Pump Subsidy (Mukhyamantri Saur Krushi Pump Yojana). Summary: 95% subsidy on solar agricultural pumps (3HP/5HP/7.5HP). 3HP pump costing 2,25,000 available for 11,250. Priority for Vidarbha/Marathwada farmers without electricity. Apply through MahaDBT portal. Beneficiaries: Small/marginal farmers <5 acres. Amount/Subsidy: Up to 95% subsidy. Applicable districts: Vidarbha, Marathwada, drought-prone talukas.

Government Resolution GR-2024/CR-112/AGR-3 dated 2024-06-20 by Agriculture Department. Subject: Crop Loss Compensation - Unseasonal Rains (Shetkari Sankat Nidhi). Summary: 842 crore sanctioned for crop loss compensation. Rates: 13600/ha Kharif crops, 18000/ha horticulture, 25000/ha grape/pomegranate. Report via e-Peek Pahani within 72 hours. Direct bank transfer within 45 days. Beneficiaries: All affected farmers with e-Peek Pahani registration. Amount/Subsidy: 13600-25000 per hectare. Applicable districts: All Maharashtra.

Government Resolution GR-2024/CR-78/REV-5 dated 2024-07-10 by Revenue Department. Subject: Farm Loan Waiver Extension (MJPSKY 2024). Summary: Loan waiver for crop loans up to 2 lakh from cooperative/nationalized banks (April 2020-March 2024). Regular repayers get 50000 incentive bonus. Apply through MJPSKY portal by Sept 30 2024. Beneficiaries: Farmers with crop loans up to 2 lakh. Amount/Subsidy: Full waiver up to 2 lakh + 50000 incentive. Applicable districts: All Maharashtra.

Government Resolution GR-2024/CR-201/AGR-11 dated 2024-09-05 by Agriculture Department. Subject: Subsidized Drip Irrigation (PMKSY Micro Irrigation). Summary: Increased subsidy for drip/sprinkler irrigation. General category: 55% subsidy, SC/ST/small farmers: 70% subsidy. Covers drip, sprinkler, rain guns. Max 5 hectares per farmer. Apply through MahaDBT. Beneficiaries: All land-holding farmers. Amount/Subsidy: 55-70% subsidy on micro-irrigation. Applicable districts: All Maharashtra.

Government Resolution GR-2024/CR-156/AGR-9 dated 2024-05-12 by Agriculture Department. Subject: Free Seed Kit Distribution Kharif 2024 (Birsa Munda Krishi Kranti). Summary: Free seed kits: 10kg soybean + 2kg tur + 5kg green manure + 50kg DAP at 50% subsidy for tribal/SC farmers. From June 1 via Krishi Seva Kendras. Carry Aadhaar, 7/12, caste certificate. Beneficiaries: SC/ST farmers. Amount/Subsidy: Free kit worth 2500 + 50% DAP subsidy. Applicable districts: Nashik, Thane, Palghar, Nandurbar, Gadchiroli, Chandrapur, Gondia.

Government Resolution GR-2024/CR-89/COOP-4 dated 2024-04-28 by Cooperation Department. Subject: KCC Interest Subvention - 1% Additional for Prompt Repayers. Summary: Additional 1% state interest subvention for timely KCC repayers, making effective rate 3% p.a. For loans up to 3 lakh from cooperative/nationalized banks. Auto-credited on timely repayment. Beneficiaries: KCC holders with loans up to 3 lakh. Amount/Subsidy: 1% additional subvention (effective 3% p.a.). Applicable districts: All Maharashtra.

Government Resolution GR-2025/CR-12/AGR-1 dated 2025-01-15 by Agriculture Department. Subject: Namo Shetkari Maha Samman Nidhi - State Top-Up to PM-KISAN. Summary: Additional 6000/year on top of PM-KISAN 6000, total 12000/year. Three installments of 2000 each (April/August/December). Auto-eligible if registered under PM-KISAN. New registrations at CSC centers. Beneficiaries: All PM-KISAN registered farmer families. Amount/Subsidy: 6000/year additional (total 12000 with PM-KISAN). Applicable districts: All Maharashtra.

Government Resolution GR-2025/CR-34/AGR-4 dated 2025-03-20 by Agriculture Department. Subject: PoCRA Phase-II (Nanaji Deshmukh Krishi Sanjivani Yojana). Summary: 6000 crore budget for 2025-2030. Farm pond subsidy up to 75000, shade net 50% up to 5 lakh, polyhouse 50% up to 28 lakh, free vermicompost unit. Target: 15 lakh farmers in drought-prone zones. Beneficiaries: Farmers in PoCRA-identified drought-prone villages. Amount/Subsidy: 75000 for ponds to 28 lakh for polyhouses. Applicable districts: Marathwada, Vidarbha, parts of Nashik/Ahmednagar/Dhule.

Government Resolution GR-2025/CR-56/WCD-2 dated 2025-02-14 by Women & Child Development Department. Subject: Majhi Ladki Bahin Yojana - Enhanced to 2100/month. Summary: Monthly allowance increased from 1500 to 2100 effective April 2025. For women aged 21-65 with family income under 2.5 lakh. Farming families with <2.5 acres get priority. Apply via Narishakti Doot App. Beneficiaries: Women aged 21-65, income under 2.5 lakh/year. Amount/Subsidy: 2100/month (25200/year). Applicable districts: All Maharashtra.

Government Resolution GR-2025/CR-78/AGR-6 dated 2025-04-10 by Agriculture Department. Subject: Organic Farming Promotion and Certification Subsidy. Summary: 100% subsidy on organic certification (up to 20000 per group) and 12500/ha/year incentive for 3 years transition period. Min 25 farmers, 50 hectares contiguous. Training through KVKs. Inputs at 50% subsidy. Beneficiaries: Farmer groups of 25+ with 50+ hectare contiguous area. Amount/Subsidy: 12500/ha/year for 3 years + certification cost. Applicable districts: All Maharashtra, priority tribal areas.

Government Resolution GR-2025/CR-91/AGR-8 dated 2025-05-01 by Agriculture Department. Subject: Godown and Cold Storage Construction Subsidy (RKVY). Summary: 50% subsidy up to 3.5 lakh for farm godowns (50-500 quintal). 40% subsidy up to 35 lakh for cold storage (5000+ quintal). Priority for FPOs with 100+ members. Apply through National Horticulture Board. Beneficiaries: Farmers, FPOs, cooperative societies. Amount/Subsidy: 3.5 lakh godown, 35 lakh cold storage. Applicable districts: All Maharashtra.

Government Resolution GR-2024/CR-167/ENR-3 dated 2024-10-15 by Energy Department. Subject: Agricultural Electricity Tariff Subsidy - Flat Rate. Summary: Flat rate 1.80/unit for metered agricultural connections. Unmetered: 97.50/HP/month. 5000 incentive for converting to metered. New connections within 90 days at MSEDCL office. Beneficiaries: All agricultural electricity consumers. Amount/Subsidy: 1.80/unit metered, 97.50/HP/month unmetered. Applicable districts: All Maharashtra.

Government Resolution GR-2025/CR-103/AGR-10 dated 2025-04-25 by Agriculture Department. Subject: Sugarcane FRP and SAP for 2025-26 Season. Summary: FRP fixed at 340/quintal at 10.25% recovery. Additional 3.40/quintal per 0.1% recovery above 10.25%. State SAP: 3500/tonne. Factories must pay within 14 days. Delayed payment: 15% interest. Beneficiaries: All sugarcane-growing farmers. Amount/Subsidy: FRP 340/quintal, SAP 3500/tonne. Applicable districts: Pune, Satara, Kolhapur, Sangli, Solapur, Ahmednagar.

Government Resolution GR-2025/CR-115/AGR-12 dated 2025-05-10 by Agriculture Department. Subject: Animal Husbandry - Dairy and Poultry Unit Subsidy. Summary: 2 lakh subsidy for mini-dairy (2-10 cows), 1.5 lakh for poultry (500-1000 birds). SC/ST: 75% subsidy, general: 50%. Includes free AI services, vet camps. Training mandatory at KVK/vet college. Beneficiaries: Farmers, landless laborers, women SHGs. Amount/Subsidy: 2 lakh dairy, 1.5 lakh poultry (50-75%). Applicable districts: All Maharashtra.

Government Resolution GR-2025/CR-128/WRD-1 dated 2025-03-05 by Water Resources Department. Subject: Jalyukt Shivar Abhiyan 2.0 - Farm Water Conservation. Summary: 1 crore per village for deepening nullahs, cement nala bunds, farm ponds (30mx30mx3m), recharge shafts. Farmer contribution 10% (waived for SC/ST). 5000 villages/year target. MGNREGA convergence for labor. Beneficiaries: Farmers in selected drought-prone villages. Amount/Subsidy: 1 crore/village, farm pond subsidy up to 75000. Applicable districts: Marathwada, Vidarbha, rain-shadow Western Maharashtra.
